title: RSIV-Harness: A Recursive Self-Improvement Harness Framework for Open-Domain Conversational Text-to-Visualization
abstract: arXiv:2610.35316v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Users often request charts without knowing which database or table holds the relevant data. Such requests may be ambiguous, and users may ask follow-up questions to deepen their analysis or iteratively refine existing charts. A useful assistant must therefore discover relevant data sources among heterogeneous databases, ask clarifying questions when needed, and track evolving user intent while preserving constraints established in earlier turns. Yet recent text-to-visualization agents typically rely on static agent harnesses that are predefined and remain unchanged despite recurring failures across tasks. To address this limitation, we introduce RSIV-Harness, which keeps the language model weights fixed and applies Recursive Self-Improvement to revise the surrounding harness from the agent's own failure traces. translated_title: RSIV-Harness：一个用于开放域对话式文本到可视化的递归自我改进框架
translated_abstract: 用户常常在不知道哪个数据库或数据表包含相关数据的情况下请求图表。这类请求可能是模糊的，用户可能会提出后续问题以深化分析，或迭代地完善现有图表。因此，一个有用的助手必须能够在异构数据库中发现相关数据源，在需要时提出澄清性问题，并在跟踪不断演变的用户意图的同时，保留先前对话轮次中确立的约束条件。然而，近期的文本到可视化智能体通常依赖于静态的智能体框架（harness），这些框架是预定义的，即使任务中反复出现失败也保持不变。为了解决这一局限，我们提出了RSIV-Harness，它保持语言模型权重固定不变，并应用递归自我改进，根据智能体自身的失败轨迹来修改其周围的框架。为了在灵活的自我改进与稳定性之间取得平衡，我们引入了一个四层框架，用于评估所提出的框架修改方案……
tldr: RSIV-Harness在保持语言模型权重固定的前提下，通过从智能体自身的失败轨迹中进行递归自我改进来动态修改智能体框架，并借助四层评估框架在灵活性与稳定性之间取得平衡，从而解决了静态框架在开放域对话式文本到可视化任务中的局限。
en_tdlr: RSIV-Harness keeps language model weights frozen and applies Recursive Self-Improvement to revise the agent harness from its own failure traces, using a four-layer evaluation framework to balance flexible self-improvement with stability for open-domain conversational text-to-visualization.
